watched #VinayaVidheyaRama — Ram Charan did a Balakrishna!!!!!

the normal template of Boyapati is…..an Emotional Family!!! a Powerful Hero!!! a Cruel Villan!!! High Voltage Dialogues !!! High Top class Fights!!! and weak Physics!!!!

but with Ram Charan & High budget on board…..Boya ensured an OVER Emotional Family!!!! an OVER Powerful Hero!!! an OVER Cruel Villan!!! OVER Voltage Dialogues!!! Over the Top Fights!!!! and Weakest Physics!!!!

this time he ensured to Brutally Rape Biology, Geography, Civics along with Physics!!!!

while Boya was busy with above….DSP ensured he did his bit to rape the concept of Music and BGM _/\_

the only positive in the whole movie is Ram Charan…who was completely at ease in deleviring this High voltage Dialogues and Fights!!!

PS : MY DAUGHTER LOVED THE MOVIE!!!!
